run_doctest_map_indexing: run the doctest suite that validates Boost.Python map indexing proxy behavior for XMap, TestMap, and AMap
test_xmap_set_get_delete: test XMap by setting, getting, and deleting key-value pairs using standard Python dictionary syntax
test_xmap_proxy_reference: test that referencing an XMap element returns a proxy that reflects mutations back into the map
test_xmap_iteration: test iterating over an XMap and calling mutating methods like reset on each element's data
test_amap_custom_converter: test AMap with integer keys and custom converters by setting and retrieving values via indexing
